singleOutcome: Forward migration and CAS lifecycle state machine for archive, unarchive, trash, restore and discard.

invariants: no physical record or typed-value deletion
one scoped row-lock and version CAS per command
TRASHED preserves exact prior status and delete metadata
typed index and search status change in the aggregate transaction
successful command emits one audit and one outbox event

assertions: idempotent replay returns the committed version
five independently missing lifecycle grants return PERMISSION_DENIED

db.flyway: seven migrations applied from empty MySQL through v4.1.0

ui.boundary: backend-only task; server action projection is verified for the frontend consumer

browser.boundary: browser execution belongs to P4-B2-03; HTTP contract is exercised against a real Undertow server

restart.boundary: no process-local lifecycle state; MySQL is the committed source of truth
